121enum class BarcodeType : uint32_t

133 // UPC/EAN extension format. Not a stand-alone format.

135 kDmcode = 1 << 10,
136 kPharmacode = 1 << 11,
137 kPdf417 = 1 << 12,
138 kVericode = 1 << 13,
139 kMicroQR = 1 << 14,
140 kAztec = 1 << 15,
141 kMaxicode = 1 << 16,

143 kUpcEan = smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kEan8 |
144 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kEan13 |
145 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kUpcA |
146 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kUpcE,
147 kCode1D = smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kCode39 |
148 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kCode93 |
149 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kCode128 |
150 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kEan8 |
151 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kEan13 |
152 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kItf |
153 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kUpcA |
154 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kUpcE |
155 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kUpcEanExtension |
156 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kPharmacode |
157 smartmore::barcode::BarcodeType::kCodabar,
158 kCode2D = BarcodeType::kQrcode | BarcodeType::kDmcode |
159 BarcodeType::kPdf417 | BarcodeType::kVericode |
160 BarcodeType::kMicroQR | BarcodeType::kAztec |
161 BarcodeType::kMaxicode,
